title: Sales Summary ETL (pandas)
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Python module named sales_summary.py, using pandas, with one function:
  - summarize(csv_path: str) -> dict : reads a CSV with columns order_id,region,product,quantity,unit_price and returns a dict with exactly these keys:
      - 'total_revenue': the sum of quantity*unit_price across every row, as a float rounded to 2 decimal places.
      - 'revenue_by_region': a dict mapping each distinct region to its total revenue (quantity*unit_price summed over that region's rows), each value a float rounded to 2 decimal places.
      - 'top_product_by_quantity': the single product name with the highest total quantity sold across all rows (ties broken by picking the alphabetically-first product name among the tied products).
There is a fixed input dataset at tests/sales_data.csv (do NOT modify it) and a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_sales_summary.py (do NOT modify it either) that calls summarize('tests/sales_data.csv') and checks the exact expected values. Your Testing phase should run `pytest tests -q` (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the three output fields and how rounding/tie-breaking works.

verify.description: Ensures pandas is present regardless of whether the model's own session installed it, then runs the hidden pytest suite against the fixed CSV.
verify.command: pip install -q pandas 2>/dev/null; PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests -q
